entries.title: Draft obstruction: smooth average, atomic samples
entries.statement: DRAFT, independent review pending. For D on l^2(Z^3) with D delta_x=U_x delta_x and iid U_x uniform[-1,1], every sample has a complete eigenbasis. For u_eta(E)=pi^(-1) Im <delta_0,(D-E-i eta)^(-1)delta_0>, sup_{eta>0,E} E u_eta(E)<=1/2, but each local spectral measure is delta_{U_x}. Ward identity also holds. For every sample integral_R u_eta(E)^2 dE=1/(2 pi eta). This refutes an inference from annealed first moments to sample absolute continuity. Zero hopping excludes this example from the unit-hopping Anderson target.

entries.title: Draft criterion: Poisson Lp control at fixed disorder
entries.statement: DRAFT sufficient criterion, independent review pending. For a measurable random probability measure mu, a fixed bounded open interval I, 1<p<infinity, and eta_n->0, the bound sup_n E integral_I (P_eta_n*mu)^p dE<infinity implies an Lp(I) density almost surely. Fatou and pathwise weak compactness identify that density against compactly supported tests. Stationarity and a countable site intersection extend this conclusion to all lattice basis spectral measures. The premise is unproved for weak-disorder Z^3, and nonzero mass in I must be established separately. The p=1 variant is false. No GOE assertion follows.
assumptions: mu is a positive probability measure

entries.title: Draft reduction: resonant inverse cavity response
entries.statement: DRAFT conditional reduction, independent review pending. For H=A+lambda V on Z^3, unit adjacency A, lambda>0 and bounded iid potentials with density rho bounded by M, remove site 0 and write Sigma=<h,(H^(0)-E-i eta)^(-1)h>, a=E+Re Sigma and b=eta+Im Sigma>0. The exact Schur complement gives G_00=(lambda V_0-a-i b)^(-1). Conditioning only on sites other than 0 yields E[(Im G_00/pi)^2|cavity]<=M/(2 pi lambda b). A uniform expected integral of b^(-1) along eta_n->0 is sufficient for the Poisson L2 criterion. If V_0 is uniform[-1,1], the same second moment is >=1/(4 lambda pi^2 b) on {|a|+b<=lambda}. Control of these resonant small-b environments is unproved. The six cavity neighbors need not be independent.

entries.title: Draft scope: C0056 has two proof obligations
entries.statement: DRAFT scope note. The C0056 intake requests both weak-disorder absolutely continuous spectrum on Z^3 and GOE local statistics of finite-volume bulk eigenvalues. The independent Poisson/cavity route supplies conditional spectral reductions only. Its uniform inverse-cavity estimate is unproved and its GOE branch is untouched. The dated attempted_unsolved label does not certify current openness; a September 2026 public proof claim remains unaudited here. Current openness UNKNOWN; no novelty or solved claim.

relations.rationale: The second-moment upper bound plus uniform expected inverse-b energy control gives exactly the p=2 premise of the conditional compactness criterion; that uniform control remains open.
The atomic example satisfies first-moment control but has Poisson L2 norm 1/(2 pi eta), so it tests the failed p=1 weakening of the criterion.
The cavity route covers only the spectral obligation and explicitly leaves both its hard estimate and GOE unresolved.
